evaluation_type_explanation: Ground truth was generated by the same deterministic extractor family under evaluation. F1=1.0 is the mathematically expected outcome of an idempotency check, not evidence of real-world contract recovery accuracy.
notes: CRITICAL: Level-2 DETERMINISTIC ground truth — same extractor family generated the GT. This is a self-consistency evaluation, NOT independent accuracy measurement.
F1=1.0 is mathematically guaranteed when evaluator and evaluated are the same deterministic function. This does not prove correct extraction.
To obtain independent precision/recall: conduct Level-3 human annotation per docs/annotation_protocol_final.md.
RESOURCE has only 3 GT positives — no per-type claim is warranted for RESOURCE.
CONTROL_FLOW negatives absent from v1.0 — FPR undefined for this type.
DO NOT cite F1=1.0 from this experiment as evidence of extraction accuracy in any publication.
